scope: Two registered task-level solver ratios, retaining all observed interruption costs.
median_definition: For two finite ratios r1 and r2, median=(r1+r2)/2.
t2_ratio_constraint: Nonnegative when defined; an undefined denominator does not demonstrate target attainment.
full_delivery_scope: This bound concerns solver ratios only; external audit costs have their separate reported scope.
decision: Complete registered T2 A and C for proof-quality and blank-control comparison. Do not replace attempts or retune frozen treatments.
